{"code":"import random, math
seq="".join(open("region.fasta").read().split("\n")[1:]).upper()
L=len(seq)
comp=str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA")

def max_orf(s):
    best=(0,None)
    n=len(s)
    for f in range(3):
        cnt=0; st=f
        for i in range(f,n-2,3):
            if s[i:i+3] in stops:
                cnt=0; st=i+3
            else:
                cnt+=1
                if cnt>best[0]: best=(cnt,st,i+3)
    return best

print("REAL +f2 ORF length:", max_orf(seq)[0]*3, "starts at", max_orf(seq)[1]+1)
print("shuffled seq  max ORF:", end=" ")
lens=[]
